XMLDB.COMMENT: Database tables for the Mnemo (VR cyberspace) course format.

TABLE.NAME: format_mnemo_building
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-activity building model overrides for the Mnemo cyberspace scene.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course module the building model is attached to.

FIELD.NAME: model
FIELD.COMMENT: A .glb model file name (resolved against the asset pack) or a full URL.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: When the override was last set.
